author: barnabasbusa
content:
I don't really like this tbh. This seems like the worst of both worlds, where you have to keep the cache stuff (that people don't seem to like) and still get no builders at the fork.

I think we need to decide whether we want to onboard builders pre fork or not. 
If we are ok to not have builders online by the fork, we might as well just disable builder onboarding altogether pre fork, and just let it happen post gloas, and then we can yeet all the cache logic.
